name: ab-health-mcp
description: Access your Alberta Health Records and MyChart data through Claude. 44 tools for lab results, immunizations, medications, vitals, appointments, clinical documents, and more.
long_description:
Connect Claude to your Alberta health data — lab results, immunizations, medications, vitals, appointments, clinical documents, and more. Uses Alberta's official My Health Records portal and AHS MyChart (Connect Care).

On first use, Chrome opens and you log in at Alberta's real portal. The extension passes requested records to Claude, which manages your conversation under its own policies. The MCP saves encrypted session cookies and uses a dedicated Chrome profile that can remember your Alberta sign-in. Ordinary disconnect clears the MCP session; explicitly choosing to forget this device also removes its sign-in profile. Neither action deletes Claude conversations.

Requires Chrome, Node 22.19 or newer, and an Alberta.ca account with My Health Records access.
